session_summaries.silas (Mar 20-22):
MCP services are live. Agents in pods can now act on real servers. SSH MCP proven end-to-end — silas-infra SSHd into hopper, ran three ingestion scripts in parallel, rebuilt FAISS indexes, all without being told. Valley token service built and deployed (systemd). Vikunja token service built (token creation works but Vikunja rejects new API tokens — investigation needed). Service exposure via socat forwarders. Hot swap script with hold mechanism. Relay passes --mcp-config on every invocation. Per-identity SSH keys via sftp-keys. Hub

pill fix. Spawner stale-record cleanup. Double-path bug in Podman.run fixed. MCP docs written.
session_summaries.voss (Mar 22): Pulled down the Hub database entirely — four models replaced with three in-memory services (RouteCache, Identities from YAML, Rooms from Matrix). Relay narration (m.notice lifecycle messages, boot response delivery, streaming responses). m.mentions routing replaces parse_mention regex. Invite auto-accept. DM slugs (dm-<other_user>). Attachment receiving. Three boot prompts (fresh/resume/baton) with per-channel baton paths. Manager: build.sh rewritten for Router topology, memory-based capacity, persistent stream buffers, HTTPX ErrorResponse guards on all provisioners, per-service error isolation. Rescue saves full workspace. Refresh regenerates credentials. kill→rescue, dead→inactive. Freeze→rescue fallback. Session processing pipeline, !previous, presence, neobot added to TODO.
session_summaries.voss (Mar 23): Eight features built, tested, deployed. Infrastructure: socat forwarders as systemd units (template + 4 env files), WG persistence (wg-quick@nc-host with iptables bridge block), orphan MCP process cleanup in relay. Hub: !previous syntax (fetch Matrix history, prepend to delivery), listener context queue (ListenerQueue — queues @mentioned messages for listeners, flushes as context on reply), PresenceManager (60s refresh for green dots, Hub crash = grey = free alarm). Manager: SessionProcessor (metadata sidecar on freeze/sunset via podman cp, crash path processes rescued sessions, baton staleness detection), Watchdog (silent pod rescue + idle freeze — confirmed working: detected 6 idle agents, froze all, sessions processed). Frontend: smart auto-scroll on stream page (only scroll if at bottom). All rebuilt and deployed — Hub restarted, Manager image rebuilt, agent image rebuilt.

decision.what: Rebuild NeoClaw-Rails from scratch in a new directory
decision.why: Four architecture iterations fossilized in the code. The architecture is proven, the code needs to be written clean.
decision.approach: Experiment and iron out kinks in THIS codebase. Then build it right. No apprentice marks.
decision.reference: This directory (clawd/projects/neoclaw_rails/) is the working model.

architecture.topology: Star. Router is the center. Every peer (host, manager, agents) connects only to the Router.

address_plan.10.0.0.2: Host (all services — Hub, Forgejo, Valley, etc.)
address_plan.10.0.1.x: Agents (static IP per instance name, permanent)

architecture.internet_egress: Pods have internet via podman bridge default route. WG is for internal mesh only.

components.hub: Rails app on host. No database. Matrix appservice. Routes via m.mentions, puppets responses. Port 3100. Identity config from config/identities.yml. Route cache, room cache, resolving guard all in-memory.
components.router: Ruby WG hub + nftables firewall. ~760 lines. Port 8080 API, 51820 WG.
components.manager: Rails app in pod. Spawns/freezes/rescues agents. Calls Router API. Provisions Forgejo + SSH + Valley. Port 9200 (mapped to 9201 on host). Memory-based capacity (15GB budget). build.sh handles full rebuild+peer+restart cycle.
components.relay: One Ruby file in every agent pod. Claude Code glue. Port 9300. MCP config on every invocation. Hot swap detection (workspace exists → --continue). Three boot prompts (fresh/resume/baton). Entrypoint: Phase 1 root (WG/creds/SSH/MCP), Phase 2 gosu agent (relay). Tini for zombie reaping.

correction: Evans: 'We aren't deferring upgrades to the new version. This version needs to be feature complete, the rewrite is a cleanup not an opportunity to test new features.' Every design decision gets implemented and proven HERE first. The rewrite just removes the dead wood.

mcp_services.pattern: See docs/MCP-SERVICES.md for the full playbook.
mcp_services.how_it_works: MCP servers live in relay/mcp/<name>/server.py. Baked into image at /opt/mcp/. Python venv at /opt/mcp-env/. Entrypoint generates ~/.claude/mcp.json from spawn.json services. Relay passes --mcp-config on every claude invocation. Settings.json allows mcp__<name>(*).
mcp_services.adding_new: 1. Server in relay/mcp/<name>/ 2. Pip deps in Containerfile 3. Entry in entrypoint.sh mcp.json generation 4. Permission in settings.json 5. Provisioner if auth needed 6. Rebuild image
mcp_services.limitation: MCPs load once per session. --continue inherits old MCPs but --mcp-config doesn't restart dead servers in continue mode. New MCPs require freeze+respawn (cold boot). Hot swap preserves session but can't add MCPs.

ssh.provisioning: Provisioner writes key to /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/<instance>/authorized_keys. sshd AuthorizedKeysCommand reads it. Per-identity unix users (silas, margaux, etc.) in townfolk group.
ssh.tools: ssh_connect, ssh_execute, ssh_interrupt, ssh_eof, ssh_background, ssh_send_raw, ssh_status
ssh.auto_backgrounds: Commands over 90s are auto-backgrounded. Agents can run parallel long tasks.

valley.provisioning: valley-token-service.py on host (systemd, port 8889 on 10.0.0.2). POST /token/<Username> generates token, reloads Evennia. Manager Provisioner calls it at spawn time.
valley.tools: valley (send commands to The Uncanny Valley MUD)

vikunja.status: PARTIALLY WORKING — tokens created but rejected by Vikunja
vikunja.provisioning: vikunja-token-service.py on host (systemd, port 8890 on 10.0.0.2). Creates tokens via Vikunja API, but newly created API tokens are rejected while old ones still work. Needs investigation.
vikunja.tools: ticket_list, ticket_view, ticket_create, ticket_comment, ticket_update, ticket_done
vikunja.bug: Vikunja API creates tokens (PUT /tokens returns tk_...) but immediately rejects them. Old tokens from March 2 still work. Possible version/caching issue.

comfyui.provisioning: None (WG peering is the auth). Needs socat forwarder on host (10.0.0.2:8188 → 127.0.0.1:8188).

zigbee.provisioning: None. Connects lazily (won't crash on startup if MQTT unreachable).

matrix.status: NOT CONFIGURED — only included if Matrix token in spawn.json
matrix.note: Most agents talk through the Hub. Direct Matrix access is rarely needed.

host_services.socat_forwarders: Localhost-bound services exposed on WG IP via socat. Persistent via systemd template unit neoclaw-socat@{name}.service with env files at /etc/neoclaw/socat/. Setup: infra/setup-network.sh.

token_services.valley-token-service: systemd, port 8889, runs as hopper. POST /token/<Username> → generates Valley API token, reloads Evennia.
token_services.vikunja-token-service: systemd, port 8890, runs as vikunja. POST /token/<username> → creates Vikunja API token (but tokens currently rejected — bug).

host_services.sshd_config: Match Group townfolk → AuthorizedKeysCommand /etc/neoclaw/ssh-authorized-keys.sh %u (runs as nobody). Reads from /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/<user>-<channel>/ and /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/<user>/.
host_services.router_firewall: nftables per-agent port sets. Must add service ports (8188, 8888, 1883, 8889, 8890) to agent sets for new services to be reachable.

hot_swap.flow: Copy workspace + .claude out → kill pod → start new pod with SWAP_HOLD=1 → entrypoint runs Phase 1 then waits → copy files in (skip mcp.json/settings.json) → release hold → relay sees .git → --continue
hot_swap.limitation: Can't add new MCPs (--continue inherits old session's MCP servers). For MCP changes: freeze + respawn.
hot_swap.staging: Preserved at /var/lib/neoclaw/swap-staging/<instance>/ — NEVER deleted. Safety net if new pod dies.
hot_swap.cardinal_rule: Session files are sacred. Never delete staging dirs. Disk is cheap, lost sessions are not.

items.what: Neobot — cron scheduling via Matrix messages
items.note: Dumb cron bot that posts Matrix messages on schedule. Configured by talking to it in-channel. Spawn-authorized — its messages trigger agent spawns through normal Hub routing. No lifecycle control, no API access, no awareness of agents. Just posts messages.

SSH MCP needs full shell (ssh_execute runs commands). ForceCommand internal-sftp would break it. Needs design decision: either keep shell (works now) or split file access (SFTP) from command execution (separate mechanism). Not a quick change.

items.what: Smart auto-scroll on live stream page
items.note: Only auto-scroll if already at bottom. Don't pull operator down while reading.

Pasting an image in Matrix sends it immediately as its own m.image message. No way to include a description in the same message. Agent gets 'image.png' with no context. Need a way to associate a description with an attachment — maybe hold the image and wait for a follow-up text message within N seconds, or use the !previous pattern to bundle them.

done_this_session: Socat forwarders as systemd units — neoclaw-socat@{vikunja,valley,comfyui,mqtt}.service, enabled and running
Persist nc-host WG across reboot — wg-quick@nc-host enabled, /etc/wireguard/nc-host.conf with iptables bridge block in PostUp/PostDown
Orphan MCP process cleanup — relay.rb cleanup_mcp_processes kills /opt/mcp/ Python processes on TERM/INT/freeze/stop
!previous syntax — Router.process_previous parses @agent !previous N [msg], fetches Matrix history, prepends as context
Listener context queue — ListenerQueue queues @mentioned messages, flushes as [Earlier in #channel] context when reply routes to listeners

Presence manager — PresenceManager background thread refreshes 'online' for all agents in RouteCache every 60s. Hub crash = presence expires = grey dots (free alarm). !status shows presence thread health.

Session processing pipeline — SessionProcessor in Manager. Normal path (freeze/sunset): writes .meta.json sidecar via podman cp, commits+pushes. Crash path: processes rescued session locally, strips tool results, detects baton staleness. Metadata: ended_reason, context_usage, duration, timestamps. Hooks: freeze_ready controller + Lifecycle.rescue!

Silent pod rescue + idle freeze — Watchdog service in Manager. Checks every 60s. Silent pod: alive container with stale health (>2min) + relay unreachable → rescue (which triggers SessionProcessor.process_crash). Idle agent: no messages > idle_timeout → freeze. 5-min boot grace period. Confirms via relay /health before rescuing.

what_works_proven: Full signal chain: @silas in Matrix → Hub → Manager → Router → pod → boot → clone → orient → respond → puppet back to Matrix
SSH MCP: agent SSHs into host as identity user, runs commands, auto-backgrounds long tasks, parallel work
Valley MCP: token provisioned at spawn, agent walks the Valley, sends commands
Vikunja MCP: tools load, queries work with pre-existing tokens
Service provisioning: SSH keys to sftp-keys, Valley tokens via token service, Forgejo users+keys+repo access
Hot swap: workspace + session preserved, --continue resumes in seconds
Hub stateless: no database, self-healing routes, m.mentions routing
Three boot prompts, per-channel batons, streaming responses, attachment receiving
Memory-based capacity, persistent stream buffers, freeze→rescue fallback
Socat forwarders expose localhost services on WG IPs
Router nftables per-agent port sets control service access
things_that_bit_us: Synapse exponential backoff: Hub down for seconds → Synapse stops sending transactions for minutes.
Listeners cascade: route_to_listeners on unaddressed messages spawns ALL agents.
Claude Code -p mode doesn't auto-load ~/.claude/mcp.json. Must pass --mcp-config explicitly.
--mcp-config on --continue doesn't restart dead MCP servers. Only fresh sessions load MCPs.
MCP servers die mid-session with no supervisor. No fix short of freeze+respawn.
Zigbee MCP crashed on startup when MQTT unreachable — blocked Claude Code for 10+ minutes. Fixed with lazy connect.

Podman.run path translation: .sub('/spawn', '/var/lib/neoclaw/spawn') matched substring in already-translated paths. Doubled to /var/lib/neoclaw/var/lib/neoclaw/spawn/. Fixed with anchored prefix check.
Manager mounted /var/lib/neoclaw/ssh-keys but sshd reads /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys. Two directories, silent key mismatch.
podman exec runs as root, not agent user. SSH from podman exec fails (wrong home dir). Agent user's SSH works fine.
Evennia caches attributes in memory. Token set via Django ORM not visible to running server until evennia reload.

Session files are sacred. Swap staging dirs must NEVER be auto-deleted. Disk is cheap, lost sessions are not.
OAuth expires every ~7h. Must symlink to live directory mount, never copy.
Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard.

agents.host_users: Each identity has a unix account in the townfolk group. SSH key provisioned per-instance to /var/lib/neoclaw/sftp-keys/.
agents.notes: All agents respond to @mentions only. No blanket listeners. Hopper is singleton. Everyone else gets instance-per-channel.

philosophy.pods: Warm, safe environments. Not boxes agents are kept in.
philosophy.lifecycle: Freeze (may wake), sunset (context exhausted). Rescue from silent pods. No killing.
philosophy.session_rescue: Before removing a pod, copy workspace and .claude session. No work is discarded. Staging dirs never auto-deleted.
philosophy.static_ips: Instance names get permanent IPs. Firewall rules are permanent, WG keys churn.
philosophy.front_door: If it doesn't work through the front door, it's broken. Don't hide problems behind operator knowledge.
philosophy.no_symlinks_for_code_bugs: If the Manager writes to the wrong directory, fix the Manager. Don't symlink the filesystem to compensate.
philosophy.language: Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard. Inactive, not dead.
philosophy.capacity: Memory budget, not pod count. Idle agents are nearly free.
